name: Onna Senshi Lucia ~Estrella Oukoku Shinkou~
original_name: 女戦士ルシア ～エストレヤ王国侵攻～
source:
It's Day 17 of a war with the invading orc army.
Lucia the warrior holds the front line in the fortress of Celias, but she's betrayed
by a subordinate and becomes the orcs' prisoner.

Commander Bodog is fascinated by Lucia's noble spirit. He sets about breaking it.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158112.html]DLsite English[/url]]
